title: A full-rank bottom kernel forces zero differential
statement: Let $X$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme], $K$ a cochain complex of structure-sheaf modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], $a\in\mathbf Z$ and $r\in\mathbf N$. Assume $K^i=0$ for $i<a$, $K^a\cong\mathcal O_X^{\oplus r}$, and $K^{a+1}\cong\mathcal O_X^{\oplus n}$ for some $n\in\mathbf N$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. If $H^a(K)$ is finite locally free of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], then $d^a:K^a\to K^{a+1}$ is zero. No reducedness or affine hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Injective square finite-free maps; applied to the bottom kernel as in Tag 0BDL matrix-chart proof

proof.text: As K^(a-1) is zero, the short-complex cycles-to-homology map is an isomorphism. Invert it to obtain a monomorphism j:H^a(K) to K^a with j followed by d^a zero. Trivialize H^a(K) on an open cover. Exact restriction preserves this monomorphism and equation, and preserves the fixed finite-free ranks. Thus each restricted j becomes a square monomorphism phi between rank-r free sheaves.

Use freeSectionsEquiv to identify sections of phi with multiplication by its square matrix A. Evaluation preserves monomorphisms, so mulVec A is injective. The column/row linear-independence equivalence makes vecMul A injective. If B is the outgoing matrix, phi followed by the outgoing map zero gives B*A=0 on sections. Apply vecMul injectivity to each row of B to obtain B=0. A morphism from a free sheaf is determined by its global sections, so the outgoing restricted map is zero.
Use naturality of the restriction adjunction unit and the sheaf hom-ext theorem on the trivializing cover to conclude that d^a is zero globally. The same proof covers zero ranks and empty schemes.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteFreeBottom_differential_zero
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (a : ℤ) (r : ℕ)
    (hbelow : ∀ i : ℤ, i < a → IsZero (K.X i))
    (hfirst : Nonempty (K.X a ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))
    (hnext : ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (K.X (a + 1) ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin n))))
    (hhomology : SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} (K.homology a) r) :
    K.d a (a + 1) = 0
